Example State University
Department of Computer Science
CPSC 237 Mobile App Development for Smart Devices (sample syllabus for tests)
Instructor: Dr. Alex Example

COURSE DESCRIPTION
This course introduces the design and development of applications for smartphones and tablets.
Students build several small apps and one larger course project.

ATS: Example Technology Hall

INSTRUCTOR
Dr. Alex Example Student Consultation Hours (in-person)
Room 101, Example Hall Monday 1:00 – 2:00 PM
(555) 010-0123 Tuesday 2:00 – 3:00 PM
instructor@example.edu
Additional office hours will be available with prior appointment.

COURSE GRADES

The course grade will be based on the grades from homework assignments, one group project,

one course project, and class participation and attendance. The following is a tentative point

assignment for the course (the points of homework are only estimates and subject to

adjustments):

Category Points

Attendance & Participation 30

Homework 150

Group project 50

Project 100

Total 330

The final grade is calculated by adding the number of points that the student earned divided by

the total number of possible points. The following table gives the final conversion scale for

course grades:

Scale Grade

90 – 100 % A

80 – 89 % B

70 – 79 % C

60 – 69 % D

59% and below F

The instructor reserves the right to adjust the scale for course grades, if necessary.

LATE WORK POLICY

Late work can gain partial credit under the following policy:

Up to 24 hours 10%

Up to 48 hours 20%

Work more than 48 hours late will not be accepted.

CLASS WEB SITE AND EMAIL
This class will make use of D2L and email to communicate and distribute materials.
All emails must contain "CPSC 237" in the subject line.
